row.Finding: XPETG CF offers greater tensile strength and heat resistance than standard PETG, thanks to carbon fiber reinforcement, making it well-suited to rigid, load-bearing parts. This added stiffness comes with a trade-off in impact resistance compared to standard PETG, so XPETG CF is best suited to applications where rigidity matters more than shock resistance.
